title: Why We Say Red Tape
short_teaser: Red tape became associated with official documents tied or bound with red ribbon.
story: Red tape became associated with official documents tied or bound with red ribbon. The phrase now describes procedures that feel unnecessarily difficult. A vivid object can become shorthand for an entire experience. Words shape what we notice and remember. Naming an experience can make it easier to understand, share, and use. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
